description: Trim exactly one source in/out point and verify the corresponding visible timeline edge. Refuses retimed clips and, by default, trims that would leave effect keyframes outside the visible clip. To set a clip's timeline length or extend a still image, use set_clip_duration.

keyframe_policy.description: How to handle effect keyframes beyond the trimmed visible range: reject (default) leaves the timeline unchanged; preserve explicitly keeps them and reports their count.

new_in_seconds.description: New source in-point in seconds (relative to the clip's source media). Specify exactly one edit point.

new_out_seconds.description: New source out-point in seconds (relative to the clip's source media). Specify exactly one edit point.

node_id.description: Node ID of the clip to trim

name: trim_clip

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Trim Clip
